descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you experienced in deriving insights and identifying patterns from data that inform decision-making? Do you enjoy shaping those patterns into recommendations that support strategic priorities across the firm?

We’re looking for an individual to lead our GWM US Business Intelligence function:

• Lead the development of a comprehensive analytics framework that strengthens visibility into prospecting channel performance and effectiveness, and advisor engagement across the prospecting funnel
• Support strategic planning and prioritization by developing management reporting, dashboards, and analyses that inform decision‑making
• Identify opportunities to streamline processes and enhance the overall effectiveness of the prospecting ecosystem
• Partner with teams across the organization to ensure the right data is collected, connected, and translated into meaningful insights
